title: Cross-Program Bonus: Tailwise Autoship and Tailwise Grooming Salon Customers Earning a Pals Rewards Tier
content:
When an earned free tier of **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** is applied, a cross-program bonus is added from two facts on the customer's other Tailwise records:

- **Autoship condition** — the customer's Tailwise Autoship subscriptions carry at least 3 charged shipments dated in the last three months;
- **Salon condition** — the customer holds an active grooming pass with the Tailwise Grooming Salon.

| Autoship condition | Salon condition | Cross-program bonus |
|---|---|---|
| met | met | 150 points |
| met | not met | 60 points |
| not met | met | 60 points |
| not met | not met | none |

**Counting the shipments (hypothetical).** Charged shipments are counted across every Tailwise Autoship subscription of the customer. Two charged shipments on one subscription and one on another, all in the last three months, make 3: the Autoship condition is met. Two in total: not met.

**The pass.** The salon condition looks at the pass status on the Tailwise Grooming Salon records: an active pass meets it; a pass in any other status does not.
